_note: Copy to config/secrets.json (git-ignored) and fill in, OR set EMAIL_GUARD_IMAP_USERNAME and EMAIL_GUARD_IMAP_PASSWORD in the environment instead -- the environment wins. These are the credentials Proton Mail Bridge generates for the account (Bridge -> the account -> Mailbox details), NOT the Proton account password. Never commit the filled-in file.
_webui_note: Optional. A shared token required on every review-console API call, presented as the X-Email-Guard-Token header. Absent (the default) means no authentication, which is only reasonable while the console is bound to loopback on a machine you are the only user of. EMAIL_GUARD_WEBUI_TOKEN wins over this file. It must never go in config/config.json, which is committed.
